title: A Journey can repeat each year and open one phase each calendar month

source.ref: Owner request 2026-10-07 (project thread "Journey overhaul"): "The year round course needs to be modified to go 12 months consecutive. Make it an option for Journeys to be ongoing." Decision card answer: "Repeat each year" (after the last month it starts again at month 1; members join any month).

detail: TODAY (before): a Journey's drip counted days only (30 days drifts five days a year off the calendar) and every Journey ended: the course home said "You finished this Journey" and the Library filed it under Finished. THE FIX: journey_plans.ongoing (migration 20270346006500, default false). lib/journeys/schedule.ts reads drip_interval_days 30 as one phase on the same date each calendar month (MONTHLY_DRIP_DAYS, clamped to month end) and ongoingCycle() names the year and the calendar's current phase once every phase has opened. The course home and player label phases Month N on a monthly cadence, point Up next at this month first, show "Year N" and never read as finished on an ongoing Journey; the Library keeps it In progress; the sales page shows "1 phase / month" and "Repeats each year". The toggle is in the Journey studio (Delivery) and the Journey settings. Progress is never reset.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=f=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=m=>{console.error("LIVE-867: "+m);process.exit(1)};const mig=fs.readdirSync("supabase/migrations").filter(f=>f.endsWith(".sql")).map(f=>r("supabase/migrations/"+f)).join("\n");if(!/journey_plans[\s\S]{0,40}add column if not exists ongoing boolean/.test(mig))fail("no migration adds journey_plans.ongoing");const s=r("lib/journeys/schedule.ts");if(!/export function ongoingCycle/.test(s)||!/MONTHLY_DRIP_DAYS/.test(s))fail("schedule has no monthly cadence or ongoing cycle");if(!/ongoingCycle/.test(r("lib/journeys/learn-route.ts")))fail("the course and player do not read the ongoing cycle");if(!/ongoing/.test(r("app/(main)/journeys/library/page.tsx")))fail("the Library still files an ongoing Journey as Finished");if(!/path: .ongoing./.test(r("lib/studio/entities/journey.ts")))fail("no ongoing toggle in the Journey studio")'
verify.note: Fails while no migration adds the column, the schedule lacks the monthly cadence or the cycle, the course or Library ignore it, or the studio has no toggle.
